name: DemoBearingBlock
_comment: Bearing housing: 40x30x28 block, centered through-bore Ø16, two mounting holes, fillet + a bore lead-in chamfer. Origin-centered; boss_extrude_midplane spans z=[-15,15] from the width=40(x)xheight=28(y) SK_Block sketch. Driving dims (BORE_DIA/BLOCK_W + friends) sourced from locals.txt; center/edge-point fields stay literal -- schema rejects {rhs} there (confirmed empirically on demo_baseplate).

features.name: FIL_Block
features._comment: 4 vertical corner edges via between_faces semantic selector, same idiom as demo_baseplate FIL_Corners.

features.name: CHA_BoreLeadIn
features._comment: Literal-point selector on the bore's top rim (radius 8, z=15) -- Cut_Bore is a cut, not a boxy of_feature with +x/-y style faces, so a semantic selector doesn't apply to its circular rim.
